title: Unit component equation for normalized finite Verdier comparisons
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, a prime l different from its characteristic, an algebraic closure Omega of Q_l in an independent universe, and a separated finite-type scheme X over D.k. For every finite Verdier datum F of [def-sf-common-stage-verdier-data], the identity-stage equality of the actual beta component with the stage unit at the dual followed by the contravariant dual of the stage unit. All coefficient fields are finite subextensions of Omega. The formulas include repeated coefficient fields and every stage object, including zero objects and the empty scheme.

source.place: Final coefficient-transport paragraph; core descent retained steps 1--5 and formal retract restriction step 10

proof.text:
identify the identity coefficient inclusion with the identity field map. Apply
RationalVerdier.extension_unit to the normalized rational extension. Its normalized
integral component is exactly the prescribed stage unitor, by the uniqueness theorem
for the canonical scalar unit and the coefficient-inclusion identity law. Transport
along the resulting equality and evaluate at the given stage object. This argument
also covers repeated fields, zero objects, and the empty scheme.

lean.statement:
theorem finite_unit_equation (F : Finite D l hl Ω X) :
    ∀ (E : Index l Ω) (K : Stage l Ω X E),
    (F.beta E E le_rfl).hom.app (op K) =
      (unitor l Ω X E).hom.app ((F.datum E).dual.obj (op K)) ≫
        (F.datum E).dual.map ((unitor l Ω X E).hom.app K).op
